empty_items_description: Add your first item using the form below.
items_error_description: Your items are safe. The app could not reach its server — check that it is running, then try again.
items_reload_error: Could not refresh from the server. These are the items from the last successful load.
create_error: Could not add this item. The app could not reach its server — check that it is running, then try again.
update_error: Could not save your changes to this item. Your edits are still here — check that the app's server is running, then try again.
delete_error: Could not delete this item. It is still in your collection — check that the app's server is running, then try again.
restore_error: Could not restore this item. It is still in the trash — check that the app's server is running, then try again.
no_matches_description: Try fewer or shorter words. Search looks at text, choices, tags and numbers.
added_status_hidden: Added “{{name}}”. It doesn’t match the search, so it isn’t shown.
saved_hidden: Saved “{{name}}”. It no longer matches the search, so it isn’t shown.
restored_hidden: Restored “{{name}}”. It doesn’t match the search, so it isn’t shown.
